content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for District Panchayat Balrampur Panchayat Secretary Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://balrampur.gov.in/. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 23-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by District Panchayat Balrampur in the state of Chhattisgarh for filling up various departmental vacancies under the local governance administrative setup.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post name for this recruitment drive is Panchayat Secretary, responsible for administrative and clerical duties at the village panchayat level.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies available for the Panchayat Secretary position under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly Offline. Interested candidates must fill out the physical application form and send it to the designated address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 23-10-2026. Applicants must ensure their forms reach the authority well before this date.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Higher Secondary pass qualification along with a 1-year Diploma in Data Entry Operator or Programming from a recognized institute.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 35 years, with age relaxations applicable as per Chhattisgarh government norms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for the Panchayat Secretary post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 3500 to Rs. 11000 Per Month along with admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General, OBC, SC, and ST category candidates as specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. How will the selection process be conducted?
faq.answer: The selection is based on merit derived from Higher Secondary marks, higher qualifications, a computer skill test, and experience as Rozgar Sahayak.
